title: Harrisburg Brazilian Jiu Jitsu and Judo East

services.name: Kids BJJ
services.desc: Monica is a paralegal by trade and was drawn to the martial arts seeking a fitness activity that she could share with her husband. Monica instantly fell in love with Brazilian Jiu Jitsu. Monica is the first female dual black belt in Brazilian Jiu Jitsu and Judo in Pennsylvania and holds a 3rd degree black belt in BJJ

explain.meaning: Brazilian jiu-jitsu, a grappling martial art done mostly on the ground.

blurb: Welcome to Harrisburg Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and Judo East, part of Central PA’s world-class network of Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and Judo instruction. We are one of the largest and top-ranked BJJ schools and the #1 USJA Judo school in Pennsylvania!
